summary: FC2088 是一款新款高灵敏度手持金属探测器，可广泛应用于各类安全检查领域。该设备具有灵敏度可调功能，探测精度优于同类产品。采用耐摔、耐用的高品质外壳设计，即使在 9V 电池电量降至 7V 时，探测距离依然保持稳定。设备极其省电，可连续工作 40 小时以上，并具备自动低压声光报警、开关机提示、声光/振动切换等人性化功能，适用于机场、车站、海关、保卫部门及考场防作弊等多种场景。
summary_en: The FC2088 is a newly designed high-sensitivity handheld metal detector suitable for a wide range of security screening applications. It features adjustable sensitivity, offering detection precision that outperforms similar products in its class. Built with a durable, impact-resistant casing, it maintains a consistent detection range even when the 9V battery voltage drops to 7V. The device is exceptionally energy-efficient, supporting over 40 hours of continuous operation. It includes user-friendly features such as automatic low-battery alerts, power-on/off sound prompts, and selectable audio-visual or vibration alarm modes, making it ideal for airports, stations, customs, security departments, and preventing cheating in examination halls.
key_application: 应用领域：FC2088手持金属探测器；新款高灵敏度手持，可以应用任何领域；具有灵敏度可调功能，与其它手持探测器相比，灵敏度较高。
key_application_en: High-sensitivity metal detection for airports, stations, and exam halls; identifies coins, keys, and weapons; adjustable sensitivity for custom security levels; long-endurance (40h+) with vibration/audio alerts.
key_parameter_1: 探测距离: 大头针 1-3cm；38口径手枪 10-15cm

parameters.灵敏度: 高灵敏度，支持手动旋钮调节
parameters.警报模式: 声光报警、振动报警可切换
parameters.探测能力: 大头针 (1-3cm)、剃须刀片 (2-10cm)、手枪 (10-15cm)、手机电池 (15-25cm)
parameters.电池: 标准 9V 层叠电池，支持外接充电
parameters.低电压提示: 电池用完时自动连续告警，电压低至7V探测距离不变
parameters.功耗: 极低功耗，单次充电/更换电池可工作 40h+
parameters.防护设计: 耐摔耐用外壳，带开/关机声音提示
parameters.用途: 机场/车站安检、公检法边防检查、贵金属检测、考场防作弊

parameters_en.Battery: Standard 9V battery with external charging port
parameters_en.Power Management: Stable detection range down to 7V; automatic continuous low-battery alert
parameters_en.Applications: Airports, customs, drug/food quality checks, precious metal detection

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 卓越灵敏度：行业领先的金属感应精度，支持手动微调以适应对小至回形针的大物探测。
  • 稳恒性能：采用先进电压稳压技术，电池电压下降不影响探测距离。
  • 三位一体警报：具备声音告警、LED闪烁及高静音振动三种模式，适应复杂环境。
  • 极致省电：超低功耗电路设计，满足长时间、高强度不间断安检任务需求。
  • 人性化交互：带开机语音自检、低电压自动灯光提示及符合人体工学的防滑手柄。
  • 安全无害：通过职业卫生标准，对起搏器佩戴者及磁性介质无干扰。
  • Figure 1 Handheld Metal Detector
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Precision Sensitivity: adjustable gain control allows for the detection of targets as small as a paperclip while minimizing false positives from background clutter.
  • Voltage Stability: high-performance power management ensures the detection sensitivity remains constant even as battery levels decline.
  • Dual-Alert Modes: features a toggle switch for high-pitch acoustic alarms or tactical vibration, ideal for noise-sensitive exam halls or loud airports.
  • Superior Endurance: designed for extended duty cycles, offering 40+ hours of operation on a single standard 9V battery.
  • Rugged Reliability: the shock-resistant ABS housing is built to withstand the rigors of high-traffic security checkpoints.
  • Safe Interaction: fully compliant with electronic safety standards; harmless to pregnant women, medical implants, and electronic cards.
